title: Steig, Michael Maynard
text: Flowers STEIG, Mike Maynard On October 1, 2018 Mike Steig, loving husband, father, son, and grandfather lost his battle to Alzheimer's disease. He peacefully passed away surrounded by his family. Mike will be forever remembered by his wife Monique, and his daughters Barbara Ganson and husband Bob; Sally Loftin and husband Stephen; grandchildren Patrick, Caroline, Luke, and Mac; stepchildren Myriem Le Ferrand, Eric Radjef and wife Tara, and Marc Yves Radjef Stone; grandchildren Morgan, Hugo, and Hayes. Mike was preceded in death by his first wife Ann, daughter Gretchen, parents Evelyn and Maynard (Jack). Mike was born in Laredo, TX on December 9, 1929. He graduated from the University of Colorado in 1952 with a degree in journalism and was a member of Beta Theta Pi Fraternity. He was a First Lieutenant in the United States Army Corps of Engineer from 1952-1954. After his service he attended the University of Oklahoma College of Law and graduated in 1957. In 1957 Mike began his career as an Oil and Gas Investor and Certified Petroleum Landman with Phillips Petroleum Company, Texas Oil Company, General American Oil Company, and Ensearch Exploration Company. He became an independent contractor in 1979. His professional memberships included AAPL, DAPL, ETAPL, Rocky Mountain Mineral Law Foundation, and State of Texas Oil and Gas Law Section, and the Korean War Veterans Association. Mike had the heart of a servant. He cheerfully gave his time to many All Saints Catholic Church ministries over the years such as RCIA, Society of St. Vincent de Paul, Vision Food Share, the Bread Ministry at the Austin Street Center, a Eucharistic Minister, and the Prison Pen Pal Ministry. He also visited the sick in the hospice wing at the Veterans Hospital. Mike will be missed dearly. His joyful spirit and sense of humor left an indelible mark on everyone who met him. He will be fondly remembered and forever loved by his family and friends. A Funeral Mass will be celebrated at All Saints Catholic Church, 5231 Meadowcreek Dr., Dallas, TX 75248 on October 8th. 11:00 am preceded by Rosary at 10:15am. Reception immediately following the service. In lieu of flowers donations may be made to Society of St. Vincent de Paul at All Saints.
